content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I have a [product_name] device ([article_no]). I want to back up its program. What software and cable should I use for this backup?
Hello [user_name], Take a look at this: How do you connect a [product_name] with a PC using the COM port?

Thanks [user_name]! I installed [product_name] software [version_no] but can't find my device in the selection list, so I'm unsure how to perform the backup. Which cable should I use to connect the [product_name] to my PC via USB?
Hi, Try selecting [article_no] Standard and use the PC/USB cable ([article_no]).
Hello [user_name], There's no need to choose the device—just click the Upload button ([product_name] → PC).
Thanks [user_name] for your information! Since I'm new to using the [product_name], could you give me a step-by-step guide for backing up a program from this device?

Hello, Step 1: Create a new empty program (LAD or FBD) Step 2: Connect your cable to the [product_name] Step 3: Click the upload button at the top of your screen (icon with the blue arrow) That's all. With newer devices, this is straightforward. For older ones, you'll need to manually set transfer mode on the device.
Thanks everyone! I'll give it a try. Can I use [product_name] ([article_no]) as a replacement for my current device ([article_no])? I plan to buy the newer one.
Hello [user_name], No problem. Take a look at the "Successor product": [company_name] Industry Online Support - Automation Service.
